summary: Verified live public marketing website at https://youarewhatyoueat.store on GitHub Pages. All requested checks passed: HTTPS with valid cert, correct page title, www subdomain works (redirects/serves same page), all nav pages load (/privacy-policy, /terms-of-service, /support, /subscribe), App Store + Google Play links present, subscribe form fires POST to correct absolute Railway URL with proper CORS headers. Expected 500 'Stripe not configured' returned as documented known limitation. No mixed-content or JS page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Known limitation confirmed: Railway backend returns 500 'Stripe not configured' on /api/stripe/create-checkout-session because STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not set in Railway prod env. CORS headers are correctly set (access-control-allow-origin: https://youarewhatyoueat.store).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live site fully operational on GitHub Pages custom domain. Apex + www both serve landing page (200 OK, correct title). All extensionless routes (/privacy-policy, /terms-of-service, /support, /subscribe) serve correct HTML pages. Subscribe form POSTs to https://web-production-66c05.up.railway.app/api/stripe/create-checkout-session with proper CORS; response 500 is expected until STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is configured on Railway. No console page errors; only expected 500 network log.
